example:
import { SkeletonArticle } from "@godxjp/ui/feedback";

<SkeletonArticle avatar active paragraph={{ rows: 3 }} />
name: SkeletonArticle

props.description: Leading avatar placeholder. `true` takes the antd default matrix: a large circle, or a large SQUARE when there is a title but no paragraph (an entity header rather than a person).
props.name: avatar

props.description: The heading LINE — not a string. `false` drops it; `{ width }` re-measures it. The default measure follows antd: 38% with a paragraph and no avatar, 50% with both, full width otherwise.
props.name: title

props.description: The body lines. Default rows follow antd: 3 with a title and no avatar, else 2. A single `width` measures the LAST row; an array measures row by row. A number is read as pixels.
props.name: paragraph
props.type: boolean | { rows?: number; width?: number | string | (number | string)[] }

props.description: Travelling sheen instead of the resting pulse; descends to every line.
props.name: active

props.description: Pass `false` to render `children` in place of the placeholder.
props.name: loading

props.description: Extra classes on the article root.
props.name: className

related: SkeletonDetail — the house record-page shape (title + metadata pairs); SkeletonArticle is the avatar + prose shape.
SkeletonRows — repeated flat rows with no avatar or prose rhythm.
Skeleton — the bare block SkeletonArticle is built from.
tagline: Avatar + heading line + paragraph placeholder — Ant Design's own <Skeleton> shape, for a comment, a profile block or a feed item.
usage: DO use SkeletonArticle where the loaded content is 'a person/entity beside a block of prose' — a comment, an activity item, a profile header, a notification row.
DO match `paragraph.rows` to the copy you expect so the layout does not jump on hydration.
DON'T use it for a table (SkeletonTable), a KPI tile (SkeletonStat) or a record page (SkeletonDetail) — those house shapes already match their targets.
DON'T nest it in a Card just to get a border; it draws no surface of its own.
useCases: Profile header while the account record resolves
Chat or review list pre-mount placeholder
